About Moana Nursery

About Moana NurseryUnravel2023-08-18T08:52:06-07:00

Serving Northern Nevada Since 1967

With a rich history dating back to 1967, Moana Nursery has been a trusted provider of nursery and landscaping services in northern Nevada. Over the years, we have expanded our offerings to include a wide range of services and products, establishing three convenient locations in Reno/Sparks to better serve our customers.

At our Moana Lane location, you will find our dedicated Landscape and Design Services Center, where our experienced team can assist you with all your landscaping and design needs. Additionally, this location features our delightful florist, providing beautiful arrangements and floral creations for any occasion.

For contractors and landscaping professionals, our South Virginia location is a go-to destination. It boasts a rock yard and Tree Land, offering a vast selection of rocks, stones, and trees to enhance your projects.

Our Pyramid Way store stands out with its expansive greenhouse, housing a remarkable variety of indoor plants. This location brings the same level of quality and care that Moana Nursery is known for to the Sparks area.

Each of our retail locations is also home to a Wild Birds Unlimited Nature Shop, offering a unique shopping experience within our stores. Whether you’re a bird enthusiast or looking to add bird-friendly elements to your outdoor space, you’ll find a great selection of bird-related products and accessories.

In addition to our physical stores, we understand the importance of convenience and flexibility. That’s why we offer online shopping for many of our products, allowing you to browse and purchase from the comfort of your own home. With options for local delivery or curbside pickup, we strive to make the shopping experience as convenient as possible.

What sets us apart is our exceptional team of certified high desert nursery professionals. We take great pride in having more certified individuals than all other local stores, chain retailers, and discounters combined. Our expertise ensures that you receive the best advice and assistance when it comes to selecting and caring for your plants and landscaping materials.

At Moana Nursery, our commitment to quality, expertise, and customer satisfaction is unwavering. Visit one of our locations, explore our online store, or contact us today to experience the Moana Nursery difference for yourself. Better Plants. Better Advice. Better Results.

What We Do

The Moana Advantage

Our knowledgeable team is here to support you in all your gardening endeavors, whether you’re looking for a single stunning plant or need assistance in designing and installing a complete landscaped yard. We take pride in growing our own high desert and alpine plants, ensuring that they are well-suited to thrive in our unique climate.

From selecting the perfect plants for your specific needs to providing expert advice on plant care and maintenance, our trained team is equipped with the expertise to help you achieve your gardening goals. Whether you’re a seasoned gardener or just starting out, we are here to assist you every step of the way.

Find a Garden Center

Moana Nursery Certified Team

Unique Facts

  • We take great pride in our expansive 280+ acre farm in Oregon where we grow our own trees, shrubs, perennials, and grasses, and our local, Northern Nevada, growing operation where we grow annuals, herbs, and vegetables.

  • All Moana Grown plants & trees are grown for our zone, meaning they have been selected and bred for success in the high desert climate of Northern Nevada. 

  • We proudly employ more Certified Nursery Professionals than all other garden centers, nurseries, home improvement stores, and discount stores in Reno and Sparks, combined!

  • Highly experienced delivery and installation teams ready to assist you. Whether you need plants, trees, or landscaping materials delivered to your doorstep, or if you require professional installation services for your outdoor projects, our teams are here to ensure a seamless and hassle-free experience.

  • Full service Florist and Reno’s largest greenhouses of indoor plants at the Moana Lane & Pyramid Way stores & Tree Land plus Moana Rock for bulk purchases at our South Virginia store.

  • A vast variety of top-quality garden supplies and products to cater to all your gardening needs.

  • Experts to assist you with the creation of compelling landscape solutions at any scope, using our experience to design, deliver and install plants, water-efficient irrigation, decorative materials, hardscapes, and birdscapes. 

  • Services ranging from Landscape to Horticulture Consulting, from Water Feature construction to Erosion Control and much more.

  • Wild Birds Unlimited at all 3 locations to give you the knowledge and supplies to bring the #2 hobby in America to your backyard! (#1 is gardening!)

We Are Hiring!

At Moana Nursery, we understand the importance of having a skilled and knowledgeable team to deliver exceptional results and provide excellent service to all our customers. We take pride in our training capabilities and are committed to hiring and developing talented individuals, whether they join us as seasonal, part-time, or full-time teammates.

We believe that investing in our team’s training and development is key to maintaining our high standards and ensuring customer satisfaction. Our comprehensive training programs equip our teammates with the necessary skills, knowledge, and expertise to excel in their roles and deliver outstanding service.
